question: Which agent-relevant microtask capabilities degrade first under common-source Qwen3-8B-Base GGUF quantization?
inference: raw completion; context 2048; max new tokens 96; temperature 0.2; top_k 40; top_p 0.95; min_p 0; repeat_penalty 1; no grammar; no cache; same task/run seeds across conditions
primary_degradation: At least 5 pp drop vs F16 and positive lower 95% paired task-cluster bootstrap bound, 10000 seeded resamples
category_analysis: Exploratory paired task-cluster intervals; no multiplicity-corrected category claim
early_failure: F16 at least 2/3 success and any Q8/Q6 condition at most 1/3 success
late_robustness: F16 and Q2 both at least 2/3 success
non_monotonic: Any task mean success increase across adjacent conditions, reported without smoothing
manual_review: Stratified sample of real failure outputs, including syntactic, semantic, and budget-exhaustion cases if observed
renderer: visualVersion 0.1 frozen; unchanged 20-task panels composed to cover all 80 tasks
scoring: Deterministic JSON/type/argument/dependency/state oracle; no LLM judge
publication: Drafts only; publish only if validation and interpretation support it
